fieldValues.title: Reader sent an essay, in Evidence-backed writing
fieldValues.summary: A person who has been sent an essay, perhaps as a link to a file on Google, Dropbox or a public repository. Unlike the writer, they are not editing and are mainly concerned with the final product; they may want to see what it rests on, and may not want to connect an agent of their own.
goals: Read the finished essay as a finished piece
See where a quote or statement comes from
Understand the background the essay draws on
Question the essay more deeply when they choose to
Read without having to connect an agent
jobs: Open the essay they were sent and read it
See the source of a quote
Follow a statement to its reference document or external url
See the problems, claims and other records a paragraph links to
Browse the background references and citations
Interrogate the essay further through an agent
Ask an agent how to connect to the essay
fieldValues.needs: The finished text without the comments it was built on, its links and references within reach, and agent interrogation as an option rather than a precondition for reading.
